title: Guild Board 1.4.0
sub: PATCH NOTES  ·  BUG FIXES AND QUALITY OF LIFE

rows.label: FIXED
items: Two-part names no longer show up twice in needs. Old duplicates merge on login.
No more mailing yourself, and the button now sits outside the mail window where you can click it.
Works for officers with two-part names. The emergency brake actually brakes now.
A reload or disconnect while fishing can't leave your music and voices muted anymore.

rows.label: NEW
items: Now sits outside the minimap. Shift+click it for your Character Card, a copy-paste summary of your character.
Behind on versions? You get an on-screen warning at login and every 45 minutes until you update.
See who in the guild is on which version. The Wall of Heroes in #guild-board shows it too.

footer: Update from the pin in #addons  ·  CurseForge auto updates once approved  ·  /gb bug to report issues
